from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer, TrainingArguments, Trainer
from datasets import load_dataset

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("{{base_model}}")
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("{{base_model}}")

cfg = LoraConfig(r={{r_value}}, lora_alpha=16, target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"], task_type="CAUSAL_LM")
model = get_peft_model(model, cfg)

ds = load_dataset("json", data_files="train.jsonl")["train"]
def tok_fn(x): return tok(x["text"], truncation=True, max_length=512)
ds = ds.map(tok_fn)

args = TrainingArguments(output_dir="{{output_dir}}", per_device_train_batch_size=2, num_train_epochs=1)
Trainer(model=model, args=args, train_dataset=ds).train()
